Subject: Vendor initiation: documents we need & PO routing steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the pilot. To get your vendor record created and enable PO routing, can you please provide the items below? I pulled together a compact checklist so we can move quickly. If you prefer, we can do a short call to walk through the list.

What we need from Solstice (please attach in reply):
- Completed vendor intake form (I attached our template in case you need it) — PDF/XLSX
- W-9 or equivalent tax document for Solstice AI
- Signed Master Services Agreement (or redlines) — if you have comments, send via DocuSign link or PDF
- Banking details (ACH or remit-to address) for invoicing
- Primary billing contact and PO email address
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) if available

What we will do on our side:
- Create vendor profile in procurement system and confirm vendor ID
- Provide Redwood vendor form (Excel) if you need to supply structured data
- Route first PO to the billing contact you provide; standard terms are Net 45 unless otherwise agreed
- If you require a payment schedule, mark on the vendor record and loop finance

Notes / small asks:
- Please name the primary billing contact and include a copy of the W-9 in your first reply.
- If you need a PO number before signing the MSA for procurement purposes, say so explicitly and we can provision a provisional PO ID for the pilot.

Attachments: Vendor-Form-Redwood.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — can you get these over by EOD Wednesday 9/9? If that timeline is tight, reply with the items you can share now and we’ll proceed.

Best,
Priya Natarajan

Elena — thanks for the quick reply and attachments. A few quick answers and next steps: 

1) Provisional PO: We can create a provisional PO under a pilot expense code (PILOT-RED) so you have a reference number while legal finalizes the MSA. That PO will be replaceable once the signed MSA is on file.

2) Invoice routing: Please send invoices to billing@redwood.ai — Marissa will pick them up from that mailbox. If you need the PO embedded in the invoice, include the provisional PO ID we’ll share.

3) Banking: We prefer ACH where possible; when you’re ready, send banking details via encrypted PDF or through our secure upload link (https://secure.redwood.ai/upload).

4) COI: fine to send in 48 hours.

Actions I’ll take now:
- Create vendor record and provisional PO (I’ll send the provisional PO ID in a separate note when ready).
- Share the vendor form back if we need anything more structured from you.
- Loop finance for any special payment schedule requests.

Marissa / Vivek / Karthik — tagging so you have visibility for billing codes, vendor ID, and GL mapping. Marissa, can you confirm the billing mailbox and GL we should use for a pilot pilot-engage?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the provisional PO later this afternoon.

Best,
Priya
